summary: RTL visual audit pass verified end-to-end against the preview URL in both English and Hebrew locales. All five fixes from the patch (useIsRtl hook, Stays See-all chevron + ms-1 flip, ImageGallery start-/end- + icon swap, WherePicker clear-X ms-1, WhenPicker close-X end-4) behave exactly as specified. Tailwind logical utilities resolve to the correct physical sides on both locales (verified via getComputedStyle), the lucide chevron icons swap symbolically (verified via outerHTML inspection of the svg), and all click-handlers remain functional. Zero console errors observed across all navigation + locale toggles.
critical_code_review_comments: useIsRtl hook is correctly subscribed via useTranslation so it re-fires on languageChanged — verified.

Stays.jsx AreaRow uses ms-1 + ForwardChevron swap correctly. Note: the back/forward scroll arrow buttons themselves (lines 405-410) still use literal ChevronLeft/ChevronRight icons without swap — visually in RTL the LEFT physical button shows ChevronLeft (which now means 'forward' in RTL reading), and the RIGHT physical button shows ChevronRight (now 'back'). The scroll() function does flip the sign so semantics work, but the icon-vs-position pairing may feel slightly off in RTL since the icon doesn't visually mirror. Low priority cosmetic — user did not flag this.
ImageGallery icon-swap + start-/end- positioning verified in both locales.
WhenPicker close-X positioned correctly: LTR right:16px, RTL left:16px (confirmed via computed styles + screenshot).
